newsitem.title: USA: May Department August same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: May Department August same store sales up.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Thursday its same store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 rose 7.9 percent.
Total August sales rose 17.9 percent to $859.3 million from $728.7 million in the 1995 period.
May said August 1996 sales benefited from a shift in the retail calendar, with Labor Day falling on the first Monday of fiscal September versus the second Monday last year.
Sales for the first seven months of fiscal 1996 were $5.70 billion, up 11.8 percent from $5.09 billion a year ago.
Same store sales for the year-to-date period rose 4.9 percent.

May said sales were restated to exclude results from stores that were closed and not replaced. Year-to-date revenues, including sales of stores that were not replaced and finance charge revenues, were $5.93 billion in 1996 and $5.30 billion in 1995.
During the month, May said it opened two Lord & Taylor stores, one in Fairfax, Va., and one in Gaithersburg, Md.
Year-to-date, May opened 21 stores, including 13 acquired locations. It plans to open seven more stores by year-end.
